This plot is very small, and I do not want to spend scarce cash on one fertilizer bag when it is too much for this piece alone. I will plant the root cuttings I know, use compost and household waste manure on the ridges, and depend on the rains because here we farm mostly with rain. I will weed it myself with family help, and I will not hire labor unless something unexpected happens, because cash is tight.
